messages:
maria: postmortem follow-up: recurring OOMs on kv-shard-4. need owners, short remediation list, and a concrete canary plan. items: low-overhead profiling, heap-scan exports, eviction/soft_limit tuning, fragmentation defrag canary, and runbook updates. suggestions?

arjun: Ill take profiling. plan to run light-sample perf and jemalloc stats, then produce flamegraphs + allocation timelines. collector commands: `perf record -F 199 -g -p $PID -- sleep 30` and `jeprof --alloc_objects`. will avoid heavy sampling in prod.

carmen: Ill do the heap-scan and upload. will run the slab-residency scanner and push artifacts to s3://redwood-debug/kv/3790123456/ by Thu EOD. also will include a fragmentation heatmap CSV.

patrick: agree on profiling. propose a temporary soft_limit increase from 60% -> 66% for a 24h canary on 8 nodes (approx 7% of fleet) to reduce churn while we gather data. will stage change behind a feature flag and monitor evictions.

maria: tentative timeline: profiling artifacts Wed noon (arjun), heap-scan Thu EOD (carmen), soft_limit canary Fri 02:00-06:00 UTC (patrick), runbook draft by Fri (carol + maria). quick retro next Tue to decide permanent fixes.

carol: Ill edit the runbook and add explicit rollback steps + playbook commands. will include how to trigger `kv-evict`, how to toggle `soft_limit`, and the slab-defrag stop procedure.

arjun: initial local replay shows persistent allocations around EncodeBulk and LRU promotion. sample log snippet:```
[2026-03-23T03:11:05Z] kv_alloc: shard=4 size=131072 site=EncodeBulk residency_ms=1.5e6
[2026-03-23T03:11:05Z] kv_total: shard=4 resident=5.1G target=4.0G
```

carmen: slab stats indicate many small free chunks but high RSS -> fragmentation. Ill include per-slab free/used histograms. if defrag helps, we'll schedule a small-scale vacuum run.

patrick: if fragmentation confirmed, we should run slab-defrag on 2 canary nodes first. need SRE approval for maintenance window. tagging oncall for signoff. :rotating_light:

maria: propose canary window Fri 02:00-06:00 UTC. carol, can you coordinate oncall and add to the runbook?

carol: will add window and checklist. rollback steps will be: 1) revert soft_limit, 2) abort slab-defrag, 3) scale down canary hosts. I'll add Grafana dashboard snapshots to the playbook.

arjun: will post perf tarball + flamegraphs here when ready (low-sample). also sharing my jemalloc export flags.

patrick: alerting update suggestion: add `kv_residency_step` metric with 5m and 30m aggregations and page at P2 if delta > 500MB. will open the alert PR.

maria: owners recap: profiling=arjun, heap-scan=carmen, soft_limit canary=patrick, runbook=carol+maria, alerting=patrick. cadence: biweekly 30m check led by maria.

carol: follow-up action: create weekly job that posts a CSV of residency growth to /alerts/kv-residency and tag owners. will put on calendar.

arjun: note: keep perf sampling conservative in prod, Ill share exact `perf` and `jemalloc` knobs.

carmen: initial heap-scan uploaded: https://s3.redwood.internal/kv/3790123456/heap-scan.tar.gz :link:

sre-bot: runbook draft created: https://docs.redwood.io/runbooks/kv-defrag-playbook-draft 1 comments open.

maria: please post a one-line status update here when you finish an assigned item so we have a linear audit trail. Ill convert these into actions in the postmortem doc.

arjun: perf artifacts uploaded: https://s3.redwood.internal/kv/3790123456/perf-artifacts.tar.gz 1 analysis pending, will annotate flamegraphs tomorrow. :eyes:

patrick: canary changes staged, will flip flag at 2026-03-27T02:00Z and monitor for 4h. will post results here.

carmen: heap-scan CSV posted; flagged suspect sites: EncodeBulk, LRU promote path, and a retention map hotspot.

maria: closing loop for now. retro next Tue to pick long-term plan (quotas, allocator tweaks, GC/defrag ops). thanks team. :thumbsup:
